item.description: This lemony chicken traybake brings bold, fresh flavour to the table - perfectly lifted by our expressive coastal Sauvignon Blanc.

item.title: Easter at Spier: Little Clues, Lawn Picnics & Long Lunches
item.description: Easter feels right at home on the farm - especially when the whole family is along for the day. Bring the kids, the grandparents, or anyone who needs a lazy lunch, good wine and a bit of fresh air - Easter on the farm is made for sharing. From clue-filled adventures for little explorers to generous meals and time spent outdoors, the long weekend is an invitation to gather and slow down together.

item.title: The Picnickery, reimagined | spier
item.description: The Cape Winelands are blessed with exquisite farm shops, and then there is Spier’s Picnickery. This much-loved stop on our farm has been transformed, not simply redesigned, but reimagined from the ground up.

item.title: Spier | Pack for a Purpose | Community Project
item.description: Bring a little more to your Spier visit by packing small items that support local community education and development projects. Travelling opens our hearts, broadens our minds and connects us deeply with the places we visit. At Spier, we believe travel can also give back, in ways that matter to the people and communities around us. We invite you to Pack for a Purpose on your journey to Spier.
